release.name: v1.5.1-native-vl.10 — tool-result images and videos
release.body:
# v1.5.1-native-vl.10 — tool-result images and videos

This release incorporates [PR #6](https://github.com/skyguan92/AIMA-AMD395-Qwen36-35B-Linux-Engine/pull/6).

- Tool results accept images, videos and mixed content through the existing native media pipeline and Qwen tool-response wrapper.
- Matching preceding tool calls, unique result IDs, a real user query, request-wide media limits and existing local/remote source policies remain required.
- Media-only results count as payload. Explicit original text/JSON errors remain failures even when accompanied by media and cannot reopen an exhausted retry window.
- Text-only behavior, thinking defaults, safe-prefix implementation and GPU arithmetic are unchanged.

## Client integration

Client SDKs and gateways must also accept tool content arrays. Existing exhausted-tool responses remain HTTP 400 with `error.code=tool_call_no_progress`, or an SSE error followed by `[DONE]` without a successful terminal `finish_reason`.

These engine checks do not claim acceptance of the original partner Harness end-to-end workflow. Original private sessions and documents are not included.

## Qualification

All final qualification gates passed on the exact candidate and portable archive.

- Native source: `ec9934446911fdf376da8eebcd83e7b137efbb7c`.
- Native engine SHA-256: `4011a436312c4bc2b3ca3a52aa6093bdf0f8f8c2dab90fb882469b4402573901`.
- Both final-source prefix-capacity profiles passed. Median partial-hit TTFT speedup was 3.38622x / 3.39325x, with decode retention 0.999528 / 1.00347, for 32768 / 262144-token capacities. These compare prefix reuse with cold execution, not `.10` with `.9`.
- All 27 exact-candidate chat/tool-media checks and 12 HTTP control-plane checks passed, as did 52 generation comparisons, 68 full-vocabulary comparisons (maximum KLD 0.0035070673) and the complete 19-cell text matrix.
- The immutable source tag is `0522a57caf24bf21e0e6fcc5b234a7fc361fbc94`. Clean-tag repository, security and evidence checks passed; Linux `make check` ran 509 Python tests with one conditional skip, plus native C++ checks.
- The portable archive is `aima-engine-native-portable-90ffe06fa1d5.tar.zst` (345,478,358 bytes), SHA-256 `7b3e4ddd69bbdd7814e89e8b81ae559246d81698e6f9352a9b26e7d6cb570cd9`.
- The exact archive passed isolation and a 3,600.000488-second resident mixed-workload soak: 360 requests, 72 each for text, image, video, mixed media and restored image. The model loaded once, post-warm RSS growth was zero, peak GTT was 85,384,773,632 bytes (below 96 GiB), and shutdown was clean.
- Rollback to the exact v1.5.1 portable archive passed, including its checksum, manifest, isolated doctor and exact q8192/128-token probe.
- The public evidence archive is `aima-engine-v1.5.1-native-vl.10-public-evidence.tar.zst` (118,207,055 bytes), SHA-256 `f3638259c0a6f5dbb348332a6b97e947987ebc6aaa5486c5159fdfc60b815a3a`. Two independently generated copies are byte-identical. Complete-closure verification passes for both `.10` and the unchanged `.9` evidence.

Only `native/src/native_chat_protocol.cpp` differs from the exact `.9` native source. All 209 pinned portable dependency/launcher inventory entries remain byte-identical to `.5`; the new native payload is verified separately. Historical `.4` GPU/VL and two-host results are explicitly inherited for unchanged components, not represented as a fresh second-host `.10` run.

The four release assets contain the portable archive, its checksum, the complete public evidence archive and its checksum. Model weights remain external and are not redistributed.

The [final qualification](https://github.com/skyguan92/AIMA-AMD395-Qwen36-35B-Linux-Engine/blob/c83e9daf0cfde5c5bf5416046f446d2eec7f8442/benchmarks/results/native-vl-g5-release-v1.5.1-native-vl.10.json) and [additive provenance](https://github.com/skyguan92/AIMA-AMD395-Qwen36-35B-Linux-Engine/blob/c83e9daf0cfde5c5bf5416046f446d2eec7f8442/benchmarks/results/native-release-provenance-v1.5.1-native-vl.10.json) bind the public records to these exact assets without rewriting the immutable source tag.

windows_actions: Classify concatenated tool text parts using the same content rendering accepted by the chat template.
Retain explicit text/JSON/wrapper failures and empty outputs across content-part boundaries.
Retain separate useful-result and different-signature silent-repair behavior.
Reject image/video and mixed-media tool content at both chat and tokenize admission; no Windows media capability is inferred.
Preserve issuing-turn ordering, unique preceding IDs, real user query, JSON400 and SSE error-plus-DONE without a success finish.
